title: Robodebt durability public-record acquisition result
question: Does the currently available official record supply a published annual debt-management-program review, a published independent-assurance result, or a subject-level pause-and-remedy chain sufficient to change the frozen Robodebt durability dimension?

query_families: annual debt-management-program review and operated denominator
external independent assurance result and tested recommendations
subject-level debt decision, contest, pre-collection pause, outcome, correction, waiver or refund, and follow-up

locators: Section 6.10 reports implementation of a debt management program and records 1,400,365 social-security debts raised in 2024–25, $2.4 billion raised, and $1.6 billion recovered.

Section 7.1 reports that, as at 30 June 2025, 21 of 26 Services Australia-led Robodebt recommendations were fully implemented, two were partially implemented, and three were undergoing an external independent assurance process.
Section 7.1 states that the debt management program developed in 2024–25 will be reviewed annually, but the report does not publish that annual review or the independent-assurance result.
The ANAO lists management and recovery of debt by Services Australia as a potential 2027–29 audit topic rather than a completed audit.
The work-program record repeats the 2024–25 denominator of 1,400,365 social-security debts valued at $2.4 billion and $1.6 billion recovered.

The record states that Services Australia developed a new debt management program in 2024–25 and plans to review it annually; the proposed future audit may test governance, quality assurance, performance measurement, monitoring, workforce capability and other debt-management controls.
Services Australia reports operation from 20 March 2026 of an indexed automatic waiver for debts under $250 and expanded special-circumstances waiver settings.
The page reports refund or credit treatment where an older repaid debt is later waived.
The implementation page does not publish an annual program review, an independent-assurance result, a subject-level pre-collection pause chain, or a successor nonrecurrence denominator.

route_ledger.surface: annual reports and current debt-management publications
route_ledger.preserved_reason: Denominator, implementation and assurance-status records were located, but no published annual review, assurance result or subject-level durability chain was located.

route_ledger.surface: performance audits and annual audit work program
route_ledger.preserved_reason: The located record is a potential 2027–29 audit topic, not an operated independent-assurance result.

route_ledger.surface: Minister for Government Services releases and advisory-board records
route_ledger.preserved_reason: No published annual debt-program review, recommendation-level assurance result or subject-level chain was located in the bounded official search.

route_ledger.surface: committee records, government responses and parliamentary material
route_ledger.preserved_reason: Located Robodebt oversight and legislative records did not supply the required program review, assurance report or subject-level durability chain.
The December 2024 implementation statement remains a status claim and annual-review promise, not the review or assurance result itself.
Current waiver-policy changes do not establish program durability, independent assurance or a source-addressed subject chain.

next_required_receipts: The first published annual debt-management-program review with its operated denominator, findings, exceptions, corrective actions and successor-system nonrecurrence evidence.
The external independent-assurance report identifying the recommendations tested, evidence inspected, implementation exceptions and unresolved residual risk.
A source-addressed subject-level case joining one debt decision to contest, pause before collection, independent outcome, correction, waiver or refund, and follow-up.

assessment.evidence_tier: Official Services Australia annual reporting and implementation publications, plus an ANAO audit-work-program record.
assessment.venue: Services Australia, the Australian National Audit Office, Parliament of Australia, Finance and Social Services ministerial records, issue 345, and the M-05 answer-effectiveness gate.
assessment.target: The transition from reported implementation and annual-review intent to observed review, independent assurance, subject-level operation and successor nonrecurrence.
assessment.upside: The record now supplies a large operated debt denominator, recommendation-level assurance status as at 30 June 2025, current waiver operations, and a defined future independent audit route.
assessment.downside: The bounded official search did not locate the annual review, the independent-assurance report, a subject-level pre-collection pause chain, or a successor nonrecurrence denominator.
assessment.failure_mode: Treating an implementation statement, a published denominator, an annual-review promise, a future audit topic, requestable debt pauses, or current waiver changes as proof of durable operation.
